notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard update-rate lookup and subscription-state services. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies named-rate lookup, active and passive subscriptions, default and reset behavior, invalid-rate boundaries, object registration, and discovery without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador getUpdateRateValue, getUpdateRateValueForAttribute, publishObjectClassAttributes, subscribeObjectClassAttributes, and unsubscribeObjectClassAttributes services with standard object-discovery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador update-rate and object-management declarations
